before: Ya Moryo lo mġaflatli mu darbayḏux.
after: Ya Moryo lo mġaflatli mu darbayḏux.
rationale: The addressed second-person form mġaflat-li has the Infectum ending -at plus first-person object -li. Retain the example and its personal-communication reference; create the transitive Infectum box if needed.
